newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Johnson, Carbone Lorraine in China JV.
newsitem.headline: Johnson, Carbone Lorraine in China JV.

text.p: Johnson Electric Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had formed a joint venture in China with Carbone Lorraine for the production of carbon brushes for automotive and other fractional horse power motors.

The new company, to be called Carbone Lorraine Shenzhen Ltd, will be 90 percent owned by the French company and 10 percent held by Johnson Electric. The company's formation is still subject to approval by Chinese authorities.
The plant, to be established in Shenzhen in southern China, will use technology licensed by Carbone Lorraine. Production is expected to start in early 1998.
Johnson Electric is a major micromotor maker.
